journal.title: OWNER OVERRIDE: risk per trade raised to 5% (was 0.5%)
journal.detail: Tony chose this explicitly after being warned. Sizing still uses the worst allowed fill (IOC limit vs stop). Total open-risk cap raised to 5% (was 3%), so effectively one full-risk position at a time. Margin cap: 10% base, raised per trade only as needed (max 60% of account equity); if a 5% trade needs more margin (10x coins at a tight stop), its size is reduced to fit, so actual risk is then below 5%. Unchanged: leverage max 40x and each coin max, stop on every trade, liquidation >= 1.5x stop distance, -3% day stop, -20% kill switch vs 37.93, min notional 10 USD. Evolution evaluates every variant at 5% and can never raise it (risk is not an evolvable parameter).

journal.title: Warning: at 5% risk the -3% day stop halts after about one full loss per day
journal.detail: A single full stop-out (about -5% incl. fees) trips the -3% day stop, so new entries stop for the rest of the UTC day. Kept as a safety. The -20% kill switch is about 4 to 5 consecutive full losses away.
